result.summary: Enables the `-Wunused-const-variable` compiler warning flag in CMake builds. To prevent warnings and errors across translation units where included headers do not use every variable, several constants in `src/logging.h` and `src/policy/fees/mempool_estimator.h` are marked `inline constexpr`.
result.problem: Header-declared `constexpr` variables without `inline` default to internal linkage, producing distinct instances in every translation unit that includes the header and triggering `-Wunused-const-variable` compilation failures when `-Werror` is active.
evidence: PR description demonstrates build failure: `error: ‘BCLog::RATELIMIT_MAX_BYTES’ defined but not used [-Werror=unused-const-variable=]`
Author notes the work is split out of #36167 to enable broader unused warning flags
result.changed_since_previous: The PR diff no longer includes subtree changes, modifying only `src/logging.h`, `src/policy/fees/mempool_estimator.h`, and `CMakeLists.txt`.
result.card: Enables the `-Wunused-const-variable` compiler flag and marks header constants in `logging.h` and `mempool_estimator.h` as `inline constexpr`. Without `inline`, header-scoped constants receive internal linkage and trigger compiler errors in translation units where they are unused. This PR is extracted as a prerequisite for enabling the broader `-Wunused` warning set in #36167.

risk.why: A faulty compiler flag could cause builds to fail on supported toolchains.
